newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden May trade surplus seen at 11.6 bln crowns.
newsitem.headline: Sweden May trade surplus seen at 11.6 bln crowns.

text.p: Sweden's trade balance for May was expected to show a surplus of 11.6 billion crowns, a Reuters poll of 13 analysts found on Thursday.
Forecasts varied between 10.5 billion and 12.5 billion crowns.
In April 1997 the trade surplus was 12.3 billion crowns.
In May last year there was a surplus of 11.4 billion crowns while for full year 1996 the trade surplus was 120 billion crowns.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, Nomura, Nordbanken, Penser, S-E-Banken, Swedbank, Transferator, and Ohman.
Statistics Sweden will publish the trade balance for May on June 25 at 0800 GMT.
